description: Angle-structured quadrature-QAE stress microcampaign for oscillatory_smooth in class G_4^(3), using the informative MLAE schedule K={0,1,2}. This campaign is scientifically preferred over K={0,1} for the degree-3 angle class, but must pass a dry-run depth check because the Phase 16 audit placed it close to the conservative depth threshold.

selected_jobs.purpose: Test whether a degree-3 angle-structured quadrature instance benefits from the full K={0,1,2} MLAE schedule on hardware.

phase16_reference.decision: reject_depth under the conservative Phase 16 max_depth=450 rule

stopping_rules: Run first without --submit and inspect the actual depth and two-qubit count on the selected backend and instance.
Submit only if the transpiled depth remains close to or below the Phase 16 value and the two-qubit count remains below 150.
If depth remains above the threshold, either perform a seed/layout audit or document the case as mathematically preferred but hardware-borderline.
Do not replace the K={0,1} result: this campaign tests whether the higher-degree angle class justifies the additional Grover iterate.
